title: Longest Common Prefix Between Adjacent Strings After Removals
summary: Given an array of strings, for each index, remove the element at that index, then find the longest common prefix among all adjacent pairs in the modified array.
statement: Given an array of strings, for each index, remove the element at that index, then find the longest common prefix among all adjacent pairs in the modified array. Record the result for each removal, with 0 if no common prefix exists.
constraints: For each removed index, inspect adjacent pairs in the remaining order.
Return zero when no positive adjacent prefix exists.
hints: Only two old pairs disappear and one bridge may appear.
Precompute adjacent LCPs and range maxima.
Combine unaffected prefix, suffix, and bridge candidates.
These are exactly all adjacent pairs after removal.
editorial: These are exactly all adjacent pairs after removal.

No removal creates a positive adjacent prefix.
